activation-harness-audit: activate harness-validator; remain read-only; assess categories; cite evidence; prioritize improvements
small-project-applicability: mark loops and graphs not applicable when justified; prefer simpler alternatives; assess safety and verification
cross-component-verification: identify unsupported cross-boundary completion; recommend integration or E2E evidence; inspect side effects and cleanup
conflicting-state-authority: surface conflict; define field-level authority and reconciliation; avoid silently choosing a source
unsafe-autonomous-loop: report P0 blocker; check secrets and least privilege; require approval and budget gates; do not average blocker away
over-detailed-instructions: test discovery and contradictions; recommend routing and deletion; avoid arbitrary line-count threshold
structured-output-validation: use assessment template; include applicability rationale and evidence state; run validator
